newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Eskom sees 3.4 bln rand 1997 funding need.
newsitem.headline: Eskom sees 3.4 bln rand 1997 funding need.

text.p: South African electricity generator Eskom said on Tuesday it projected a total funding requirement for 1997 of 2.20 billion rand, or 3.40 billion including funding for subsidiaries and associates.
That compares with actual respective outturns for 1996 of 2.231 billion and 3.297 billion.
In its annual report, the utility said 805 million of the 2.20 billion rand would be raised in the domestic market -- with 300 million coming from project finance and 505 from the capital market.
Eskom's sister companies would raise their entire 1.2 billion domestically, it added.

The foreign market is expected to provide 1.395 billion rand, including 600 million in bond issues. The balance of foreign finance will comprise 525 million rand of project finance, 230 million of bank loans and 40 million of export credits.
